======================================================================
17. RESTATE THE PROGRAM-ORDER EXCEPTION
======================================================================

Create one stable owner-decision identity for the program-order exception.

Its exact meaning is:

    SCI-FRUIT Stage B may author the generic conditional scientific core before
    an exact numerical FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD has been owner-approved or
    numerically qualified.

This exception changes only the ordinary authorship sequence.

It permits Stage B to define:

- scientific roles;
- typed spaces and operator signatures;
- conditional equations;
- response and uncertainty consequences under explicit premises;
- state, iteration, continuation, termination, and terminal-product meanings;
- required method-record contents;
- typed unavailable states;
- falsifiable conditional predictions.

It does not authorize:

- a numerical parent route;
- a numerical model;
- a numerical projector;
- a residual-processing operator;
- a rejoin operator;
- an update or recurrence;
- grouping;
- support behavior;
- a learning schedule;
- a convergence threshold;
- an iteration limit;
- a terminal-selection rule;
- numerical uncertainty;
- implementation conformity;
- validation or production.

Record the current numerical method state as:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD
      = unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

Do not call the scientific remove-process-rejoin composition a “sequence
exception.”

======================================================================
18. FORMALIZE THE CONDITIONAL SCIENTIFIC COMPOSITION SEPARATELY
======================================================================

The conditional core may define the ordinary role ordering:

    remove declared model contribution
      ->
    process the residual while the declared model path bypasses the named
    residual operation
      ->
    rejoin the declared model contribution.

Use typed abstract relations such as:

    rho_k
      = y_k^in - Pi_k m_k

    z_k
      = F_k(rho_k) + B_k m_k.

Here:

    y_k^in
      = exact iteration input;

    m_k
      = exact accepted model applied at iteration k;

    Pi_k
      = abstract model-to-removal-domain projection;

    F_k
      = abstract complete residual-processing procedure;

    B_k
      = abstract model-to-rejoin-domain map;

    z_k
      = exact iteration result.

This is a conditional scientific composition and role order. It is not a
selection of numerical Pi_k, F_k, or B_k.

Do not assume:

- Pi_k = B_k;
- B_k is the inverse of Pi_k;
- F_k is linear;
- removal and rejoin have equal support;
- the model and measured signal share a numerical domain;
- every named upstream operation is bypassed;
- the iteration consumes the original parent rather than the prior result;
- the model is true sky;
- the rejoined path has unit response.

When and only when a declared method supplies a fixed linear residual operator:

    F_k(rho) = A_k rho,

the conditional core may derive:

    z_k
      = A_k y_k^in
        + (B_k - A_k Pi_k) m_k.

That equation remains conditional on the declared spaces, support, state, and
operator identities. It does not make any numerical operator available.

A method using another sign, ordering, affine term, nonlinear operation,
recomputed coefficient, relearned state, or support rule requires its own exact
method identity.

======================================================================
19. KEEP THE TWO AUTHORITIES DISTINCT
======================================================================

Bind separately:

A. program-order authority

    permission to author the conditional core before numerical-method
    qualification;

B. conditional scientific-composition authority

    permission to derive consequences of the declared
    remove -> residual process -> rejoin role structure under explicit
    assumptions;

C. numerical-method authority

    the still-unavailable FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD that must eventually supply
    actual operators, recurrence, grouping, support, learning, stopping,
    terminal selection, and failure behavior.

Approval of A or B does not imply C.

Please update the Scope Brief, decision ledger, manifest, and Stage B author
instructions so the phrase “narrow sequence exception” cannot be mistaken for
a numerical sequence decision.
